title: (RHBA-2019:0858) Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.2.7 for OpenShift image security update
portal_summary:
An updated image is available for Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.2.7, running on
OpenShift Container Platform 3.10 and 3.11.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.2.7 for OpenShift image security update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.10|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.11|x86_64
portal_solution:
To update to the latest Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.2.7 for OpenShift
image, run the following steps to pull in the content:

1. On your master host(s), ensure you are logged into the CLI as a
cluster administrator or user with project administrator access
to the global "openshift" project. For example:

$ oc login -u system:admin

2. Update the Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.2.7 OpenShift streams in the "openshift" project by running the following command:

$ oc -n openshift import-image redhat-sso72-openshift:1.4
portal_description:
Red Hat Single Sign-On is an integrated sign-on solution available as a
Red Hat JBoss Middleware for OpenShift containerized image. The Red Hat
Single Sign-On for OpenShift image provides an authentication server for
users to centrally log in, log out, register, and manage user accounts
for web applications, mobile applications, and RESTful web services.

Security Fixes:

  Red Hat Single Sign-On AuthenticationManager previously set the session token cookies in a way that made the application vulnerable to system attackers. Both active and inactive sessions of other Red Hat
Single Sign-On users could be hijacked (CVE-2019-3868).

This erratum releases an updated image for Red Hat Single Sign-On 7.2.7
for use with the OpenShift Container Platform 3.10 and  the
OpenShift Container Platform 3.11 cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service
(PaaS) for on-premise or private cloud deployments, aligning with the
standalone product release.
